_comment: Provenance of the vendored Filament.js runtime — the machine-readable half of the
ABI invariant for the static site (#2783). Before this file, the only record of
which Filament.js was vendored was an HTML comment, and it was wrong: three pages
and the materials README all said 1.70.2, while the committed bytes are 1.70.1.
`version` MUST equal `filamentWebsite` in gradle/libs.versions.toml — that pin is
what tools/GenerateFilamat.sh uses to compile website-static/materials/*.filamat,
and Filament parses a material package only when its MATERIAL_VERSION matches the
runtime exactly. `sha256` pins the bytes so the runtime cannot be swapped without
moving the pin (and regenerating the blobs) in the same change.
